title: Maintaining Correct Drainage Pitch for Solids Transport
description: Proper drainage performance relies on maintaining an accurate, continuous slope along horizontal drain lines. If a drain line has insufficient slope, water moves too slowly, allowing heavy organic solids and grease to settle and form stubborn blockages. Conversely, an excessive pitch can allow liquid to outrun solid waste, leaving dry debris behind to collect over time. Always verify local plumbing code requirements for required fall per foot based on pipe diameter, and use a reliable torpedo level during rough-in installation to ensure consistent flow velocity and proper waste transport.

Maintaining Correct Drainage Pitch for Solids Transport

Proper drainage performance relies on maintaining an accurate, continuous slope along horizontal drain lines. If a drain line has insufficient slope, water moves too slowly, allowing heavy organic solids and grease to settle and form stubborn blockages. Conversely, an excessive pitch can allow liquid to outrun solid waste, leaving dry debris behind to collect over time. Always verify local plumbing code requirements for required fall per foot based on pipe diameter, and use a reliable torpedo level during rough-in installation to ensure consistent flow velocity and proper waste transport.
